name: Layout Composer
description: Cartographic print layout designer: map frames with locked scale and custom shapes, DMS/DD/UTM grids, inset maps, auto legends for vector, raster and tile layers, matplotlib-style color bars, dual-unit scale bars, LaTeX, drawing tools, icon catalog, templates, and PNG/PDF/vector PDF/GeoPDF/SVG export.
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
